titles: "정크본드 수준"이던 한국 신용등급, 3대 신평사 모두 프랑스를 앞지른 진짜 이유
하루 만에 4단계 강등됐던 한국 신용등급, 3대 신평사 모두 프랑스보다 위인 진짜 이유
"한국 B+, 프랑스 AAA"였던 신용등급… 3대 신평사 모두 뒤집힌 진짜 이유
thumbnail_texts: "1997 B+ → 지금 AA" / 신용등급, 3사 모두 한국이 위
"하루 만에 4단계 강등" / 그 한국, 신용등급 프랑스 위로

image_concepts.A: 한 장면의 거대한 등급 계단 — 위쪽 햇빛 속 서울과 태극기, 아래쪽 그늘진 파리
image_concepts.B: 1997년 겨울 은행 환전 창구와 신문 더미 → 뒤쪽 햇빛 받는 지금의 한국은행

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 장면 대비. 하늘로 이어지는 거대한 돌계단, 오른쪽 위 꼭대기엔 햇빛 받는 서울 도심과 크게 휘날리는 태극기, 왼쪽 아래 계단참엔 회청색 그늘 속 에펠탑과 작은 삼색기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic scene of a gigantic weathered stone staircase rising diagonally from lower left to upper right across the upper half of the frame. At the sunlit top right, a gleaming modern Seoul skyline with a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in bright sunlight, golden backlight, glowing rim light and lens flare, heroic low-angle shot. At the lower left landing, the Eiffel Tower and a small ordinary French tricolor flag sit in cold blue-grey shade on lower steps, untouched and dignified. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain, scratched and weathered stone textures, dramatic volumetric clouds, bright high-key daylight with lifted shadows, split accents of electric blue on the Korean side versus warm orange haze on the French side, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패 구도. 왼쪽 파리 의사당 앞 회색 하늘과 작은 삼색기, 가운데 놀라 오른쪽을 바라보는 익명의 60대 프랑스 금융인, 오른쪽 햇빛 받는 여의도 빌딩숲과 큰 태극기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic three-part comparison composition in the upper half. Left: the Palais Bourbon in Paris under a flat grey overcast sky with a small ordinary French tricolor flag, desaturated and dusty. Center: an attractive anonymous French financier in his 60s with a warm likeable face, grey suit, jaw-dropped awestruck expression, chest-up close-up filling 60 percent of the frame height, looking toward the right side. Right: the Yeouido financial district skyline in Seoul glowing in bright golden backlight with a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving in the upper right corner, sparks of light, triumphant epic cinematic mood. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain, crisp glass and metal textures, bright daylight exposure, electric blue versus warm orange accents.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업 + 시간 대비. 앞쪽엔 1997년 겨울 은행 환전 창구의 빛바랜 전광판과 신문 더미를 든 익명 50대 한국 남성(걱정스러운 표정), 뒤쪽 창 너머로 햇빛 받는 지금의 한국은행 본관.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up scene inside a 1997 Korean bank foreign exchange counter in winter: a faded old electronic rate board with blank glowing segments, a stack of old newspapers, and an anonymous Korean man in his 50s in a thick winter coat with a worried, tense expression holding a newspaper, rendered in faded sepia tones in the foreground. Through a large window behind him, the stately stone Bank of Korea headquarters building in Seoul stands in bright present-day sunlight, vivid and sharp with a Korean flag on its roof. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, film grain, scratched and weathered textures on the counter, bright lifted shadows, strong contrast between the faded past foreground and the brilliant present background.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업. 낡은 1990년대 신문 한 부가 바람에 날리는 위로, 같은 각도의 반짝이는 한국은행 금고 속 달러 지폐 더미가 겹쳐 빛난다. 익명 한국인 은행원이 자신감 있게 미소.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic close-up of a crumpled yellowed 1990s newspaper sheet with blank columns lying on a worn wooden counter in cold shadow on the left, and on the right a brightly lit open bank vault stacked high with neat bundles of US dollar banknotes glowing under golden light. An attractive anonymous Korean bank officer in his 40s with a warm likeable face and confident proud smile stands beside the vault, arms crossed. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain, crisp paper and metal textures, dust particles in the air, bright high-key daylight, electric blue and warm orange split accents, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 한 장면 대비. 거대한 저울 위 — 오른쪽 접시엔 빛나는 태극기와 서울 남산타워 미니어처가 위로 올라가 있고, 왼쪽 접시엔 그늘진 에펠탑 미니어처가 아래로 내려가 있다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic scene of a giant antique brass balance scale towering in the upper half of the frame against dramatic volumetric clouds. The right pan, raised high and glowing in golden sunlight, holds a detailed model of Seoul's N Seoul Tower with a large Korean flag Taegukgi waving above it, lens flare and sparks. The left pan, sunk lower in cool blue-grey shade, holds a detailed model of the Eiffel Tower with a small ordinary French tricolor flag, calm and dignified, not damaged. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain, scratched and weathered brass textures, bright high-key daylight with lifted shadows, electric blue versus warm orange accents, triumphant cinematic mood.
